sources.snippet: 🔥 News: 2024/11/08: We have released the CogVideoX1.5 model. CogVideoX1.5 is an upgraded version of the open-source model CogVideoX. The CogVideoX1.5-5B series supports 10-second videos with higher resolution, and CogVideoX1.5-5B-I2V supports video generation at any resolution.
